//Endpoint: Set per environment, NOT here. This endpoint is used by the livekit-egress worker, which
runs on HOST networking — a bridge-network service name like http://intellilect-s3:9000
resolves for this service but never for the uploader, so recordings encode fine and then
fail silently at upload. Compose supplies MinIO's host-published address instead.
Blank = default AWS S3. The effective value is reported by the egress health check.

//Media: LiveKit CLIENT settings, sent to the browser with the join token. See MediaOptions.cs for why
each value is what it is — three of them must not be changed without reading the reasons.
DO NOT CHANGE: Dtx and StopMicTrackOnMute feed the AI assistant's audio frame stream and its
pause detection. Simulcast is what AdaptiveStream selects from.
DEFERRED: AudioPreset -> 'speech' only after STT is verified (an SFU forwards this exact audio
to the transcriber). VideoCodec -> 'h264' only after testing Firefox/Safari simulcast.
The LIVE stream is where the resolution budget is spent (1080p capture, 3 Mbps share) and the
Egress section is deliberately held DOWN at 960x540 to pay for it — the room judges the stream
in real time, the recording is watched later from a file. Read both together before raising
either: on one host they compete for the same encoder headroom.
